title: Aureline M5 rehearsal-drill readiness record
description: Canonical per-domain record for the explicit rehearsal-drill readiness decision on a launch-bearing lane. Names the roster coverage — full roster, backup roster, or conditional roster — and preserves the resolved coverage identity, the rehearsal evidence ledger, the ORR signoff reference, the named on-call roster state, the rehearsal-freshness state, the authorized widening stage, and the last rehearsal-drill revision that justified widening, so rehearsal freshness and role coverage read as first-class blockers and a lane can never imply green while its rehearsal packet is stale or its roster coverage is missing. Downstream shiproom, release-center, executive-steering, program-governance, docs, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a lane's rehearsal posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
